messages:
kai: Heads-up — seeing ~3.5ms median increase on requests that hit paged-flash-attn after yesterday's kernel-selector change. Spike visible across prod cluster us-west-2, started ~08:45 UTC. Dashboard: https://redwood/p/metrics/attn-latency?range=2h :thinking_face:

maria: which change specifically? the selector heuristic rolled in commit 7c9a1ab?

kai: yes, 7c9a1ab — "prefer-fused-for-short-seqs" flag turned on. Metric shows baseline 12.1ms -> 15.6ms (p50)

deploy-bot: deploy 7c9a1ab to prod/us-west-2 completed at 08:42 UTC by ci-cd

alex: can you dump a profiler trace for a sample request? also check kv cache miss rate, sometimes selector pushes to flash variant that thrashes cache

kai: attached flamegraph (link) and sample trace: https://redwood/traces/xyz

sarah: I see KV miss rate jump from 2% -> 9% in same window. Those requests show larger keyset churn. suspicious

alex: quick repro locally with env to force new selector:
```
REDWOOD_KERNEL_SELECTOR=prefer-fused-for-short-seqs ./serving_bench --model llama-7b --seq-len 64 --qps 20 --profile=output.pb
``` 
Result: median 14.9ms. Re-run forcing old selector:
```
REDWOOD_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy ./serving_bench --model llama-7b --seq-len 64 --qps 20 --profile=output_old.pb
``` 
Result: median 11.8ms

maria: interesting — suggests selector path causes worse kv locality or suboptimal kernel choice for our typical seq distribution

tj: propose rollback to selector=legacy in us-west-2 as a quick mitigation while we bisect. Anyone opposed?

alex: +1 rollback. I can push a canary rollback to 10% now and measure.

deploy-bot: rollout start: rollback selector to legacy at 08:58 UTC — canary 10% (deploy id abc123)

alex: canary metrics look good, p50 back to 12.0ms. I'll escalate to 50% if stable

sarah: I'll pull detailed KV traces for the period and annotate

maria: I'll own the bisect — plan: narrow commits between 7c9a1ab (introduces flag) and 7c9a1ab~3 (last known good). Running binary search over the 3 intermediate commits and validate both latency and KV miss rate. Will post per-commit results.

kai: thanks. action items: alex observe rollout, maria bisect, sarah KV trace analysis. ping me if rollback needs expanding. :thumbsup:

alex: expanding to 50% now

deploy-bot: canary expansion: 50% at 09:05 UTC (deploy id abc123)

maria: starting bisect run now (ETA ~40m)

sarah: KV trace extraction started

kai: great, keep thread updated. If bisect pins it to selector logic we should also add a micro-benchmark for cache mobility.

maria: noted — adding perf test to repo

alex: update: 50% stable for 10m, going full rollback 100% in 5m

deploy-bot: rollback complete 100% at 09:12 UTC

kai: closing for now, open follow-up ticket to adjust kernel selector heuristics and add guardrails (auto-fallback on throughput/kv-miss spike)

maria: created ticket RW-5123

kai: thanks everyone
